description: Rendered timelapse clips for a resort's webcams (or one cam), as links: the rolling 24-hour MP4 per cam (H.264, 7 fps, 720p max, at most 3 MB, re-rendered every 6 hours from PeakCam's still archive) with its poster JPEG and frame bounds, plus storm reels (rendered while the resort's measured 24 h new snow is 8 in or more, from the first frame after the last dry day, capped at 72 h; one per storm day, kept a year). Only cams whose operator allows archiving have clips. Use it for "show me the last 24 hours" or "show me the last storm" questions; get_cam_timeline returns the individual frames. Media is never returned inline.

camId.description: Optional: one cam's id from get_resort_cams; default is every cam with a clip.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

available.description: False when the clip table is not served by this deployment yet.

cams.description: Only cams with at least one clip, in the resort's cam order.

credit.description: Attribution line for the frames; null means credit the resort.
